defects.condition: the CSS is injected by JavaScript
defects.says: puts the code that injects the CSS in front of the chunk without shifting its source map, so the map the bundler combines from it loses sources

lines: 1 package is imported by their root in src, so the whole barrel is reachable and the bundler keeps whatever it cannot prove unused:

@nextcloud/vue: 727,857 B in 112 modules, 16.0 % of the static path of tables-main.mjs, imported by its root in 108 files: App.vue (NcAppContent, NcContent), modules/main/partials/ColumnInfoPopover.vue (NcPopover, NcUserBubble), and 106 more. It is imported per module as well, through 8 other specifiers.
Importing the module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
ncmake's lint-vue-imports workflow gates exactly this specifier for @nextcloud/vue, so this finding is that red check with a byte figure attached.
Built with: vite.config.ts, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^2.5.4, vite ^7.3.6.
Written against: vue 3.5.42, 18 delivered packages; @floating-ui/dom 1.1.1, 1.8.0, 6 delivered packages; @tiptap/pm 3.31.3, 22 delivered packages; axios 1.20.0, 3 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 106, moment 2.31.0, webdav 5.10.0, date-fns 4.4.0, vue-material-design-icons 5.3.1, dompurify 3.4.16, micromark-core-commonmark 2.0.3, and 100 more.
Packages and versions are those the .license files beside the chunks name, since the source maps miss packages through the toolchain defect named here.

Known toolchain defect: vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 4.0.1 in package-lock.json, where the CSS is injected by JavaScript, puts the code that injects the CSS in front of the chunk without shifting its source map, so the map the bundler combines from it loses sources. Here the map of tables-main.mjs names 1 of the 5 packages its .license file names.
The app runs as built; only the map is short, so the frameworks and libraries are read from the .license files instead.

Built in a copy with @nextcloud/vite-config 3.0.0-beta.1, vite 8.3.5 (vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 5.0.3), the map of uz-DFWwGyW1.chunk.mjs names 3 of the 6 packages its .license file names still: not fixed.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.
